cat > /root/autodl-tmp/event-gated-adaptive-horizon/scripts/exp_021_full_sgs_cheetah_s1.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# exp_021_full_sgs_cheetah_s1: Full-SGS Cheetah Run
# Hypothesis: Full-SGS (blocking obs+reward+cont decoder gradients to dt_emb)
# prevents CIVO in Cheetah, validating cross-environment SGS effectiveness.
# Compare with exp_010b (Cheetah CIVO trigger, NVE 8.63×, collapse).

set -euo pipefail
CUDA_ID=${CUDA_ID:-0}

cd /root/autodl-tmp/event-gated-adaptive-horizon

unset CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base

export LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libstdc++.so.6
export MUJOCO_GL=egl
export MUJOCO_EGL_DEVICE_ID=${CUDA_ID}

python -u dreamer.py \
  --configs defaults dmc_proprio \
  --task dmc_cheetah_run \
  --gate_enabled True \
  --gate_fixed_dt 2 \
  --gate_subsample_max_dt 2 \
  --imag_horizon 8 \
  --full_sgs True \
  --seed 1 \
  --steps 105000 \
  --checkpoint_every 10000 \
  --compile False \
  --device cuda:${CUDA_ID} \
  --logdir ./logdir/exp_021_full_sgs_cheetah_s1
EOF
chmod +x /root/autodl-tmp/event-gated-adaptive-horizon/scripts/exp_021_full_sgs_cheetah_s1.sh

cd /root/autodl-tmp/event-gated-adaptive-horizon && /root/miniconda3/bin/python -c "
import yaml
with open('configs.yaml') as f:
    configs = yaml.safe_load(f)
print('dmc_proprio exists:', 'dmc_proprio' in configs)
print('full_sgs in defaults:', configs.get('defaults', {}).get('full_sgs', 'NOT FOUND'))
print('Config parse OK')
"
